verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-management SaaS, and such products can plausibly ship in-app AI assistants, so this axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an in-app AI assistant that learns a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences. Story templates and the MCP server for external agents are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
